author: Darth_Ernie
body: Dark rifts are unique dungeons found in the real world like the tree ones from the Yggdrasil questline

author: dreambig5
body:
Yeah....for some reason they changed it up AGAIN. I have about 10-15 dungeons (only 3-4 of those being this specific dungeon) in my viewing distiance. & while it would've been nice to just enter those, use the dark rift keys & keep running trains on Zagreus, I understand why they made them into seperate dungeons. 

That being said, doing dungeon horde boss dungeons still gives plenty of event xp & currency/other materials to be able to buy what you want from the Monumental store. 

I do wish they went back to the previous method because this feels quite inconvenient. That being said, I'm just about to get my 50 event tokens to be able to the get the Zagreus pet on my main & my alt so w/e.
